Name: Nyapu Style Portraits for Rahiel
Author: chlkyy
Description:
[b]This mod has no content patcher components, it consists of files to replace the portraits in the base mod. To install, drag and drop the images in the corresponding folders and replace the base portraits.[/b]

[b]Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu]Nyapu[/url] for their portraits, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/jierishi]jierishi[/url] for the base mod![/b]
